# Lets Watch

> Lets Watch is a local-first watch-party app for self-hosted environments. Each viewer opens the video file from their own machine, while the server only coordinates playback state over Socket.IO.

Important notes:

- Built with React 19 + Vite (frontend) and Express + Socket.IO (backend).
- Emphasizes privacy: media remains local, chat history isn't stored on the server.
- Security controls include Helmet, Zod validation, rate limiting, and explicit CORS headers.
- Uses WebSockets to sync play, pause, and seek events across a room with shared participant control.
- Room access is protected by a 6-digit PIN and rate limits on join attempts.
- Deployed and managed in production using PM2.
